title: 第十八课 · 路上辛苦了
subtitle: Lesson 18 — 路上辛苦了 · Did you have a tiring trip

items.en: to be late, to be behind schedule
to be about to, to be going to
in a moment, a little while
to drive; to start; to open
to invite; to treat (sb. to a meal)

items.py: Dàgài sān diǎn bàn néng dào.

items.zh: 我们先去喝点儿咖啡，一会儿再来这儿吧。
items.py: Wǒmen xiān qù hē diǎnr kāfēi, yīhuìr zài lái zhèr ba.
items.en: Let's have some coffee first and come back here later.
You must have had a tiring trip.

items.py: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ yào lái?
items.en: How did you know I would come?
What time does the plane arrive?
I'll pick you up at the airport.

items.zh: 坐了十几个小时的飞机。
items.py: Zuò le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí de fēijī.
items.en: I was on the plane for over ten hours.

data.topic: 会话1 · Dialogue 1 (At the Airport — Waiting)

items.zh: 和子：从东京来的飞机到了吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Cóng Dōngjīng lái de fēijī dào le ma?
items.en: Hezi: Has the flight from Tokyo arrived?

items.zh: 服务员：晚点了。飞机现在在上海。
items.py: Fúwùyuán: Wǎndiǎn le. Fēijī xiànzài zài Shànghǎi.
items.en: Attendant: It's delayed. The plane is currently in Shanghai.
Attendant: It's about to take off.

items.zh: 服务员：大概三点半能到。
items.py: Fúwùyuán: Dàgài sān diǎn bàn néng dào.

items.zh: 和子：刘京，我们先去喝点儿咖啡，一会儿再来这儿吧。
items.py: Hézǐ: Liú Jīng, wǒmen xiān qù hē diǎnr kāfēi, yīhuìr zài lái zhèr ba.
items.en: Hezi: Liu Jing, let's go have some coffee first and come back later.

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (At the Airport — Meeting Li Chengri)

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ kàn, Lǐ Chéngrì lái le.
items.en: Hezi: Look, Li Chengri is here.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ hǎo! Lù shang xīnkǔ le.
items.en: Liu Jing: Hello! Did you have a tiring trip?

items.zh: 李成日：你们好！刘京，你怎么知道我要来？
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì: Nǐmen hǎo! Liú Jīng, nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ yào lái?
items.en: Li Chengri: Hello! Liu Jing, how did you know I was coming?

items.py: Liú Jīng: Shì Hézǐ gàosu wǒ de.

items.zh: 李成日：感谢你们来接我。
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì: Gǎnxiè nǐmen lái jiē wǒ.
items.en: Li Chengri: Thank you for coming to pick me up.

items.zh: 李成日：等一等，还有贸易公司的人接我呢。
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì: Děng yī děng, hái yǒu màoyì gōngsī de rén jiē wǒ ne.
items.en: Li Chengri: Wait a moment, someone from the trading company is also here to meet me.

items.zh: 刘京：好，我们在这儿等你。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Hǎo, wǒmen zài zhèr děng nǐ.
items.en: Liu Jing: OK, we'll wait for you here.

data.topic: 会话3 · Dialogue 3 (At the Airport — Picking Up David)

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ shì Dàwèi ba?
items.en: Liu Jing: Hello! You must be David?

items.py: Dàwèi: Shì de. Nǐ shì Liú Jīng ma?
items.en: David: Yes. Are you Liu Jing?

items.zh: 刘京：对，我是刘京。欢迎你来中国！路上辛苦了！
items.py: Liú Jīng: Duì, wǒ shì Liú Jīng. Huānyíng nǐ lái Zhōngguó! Lù shang xīnkǔ le!
items.en: Liu Jing: Yes, I'm Liu Jing. Welcome to China! You must be tired!

items.zh: 大卫：不辛苦。谢谢你来接我。
items.py: Dàwèi: Bù xīnkǔ. Xièxie nǐ lái jiē wǒ.
items.en: David: Not at all. Thanks for picking me up.

items.zh: 刘京：不客气。你的行李都拿了吗？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Bú kèqi. Nǐ de xíngli dōu ná le ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: You're welcome. Have you got all your luggage?

items.zh: 大卫：拿了。就这两个箱子。
items.py: Dàwèi: Ná le. Jiù zhè liǎng ge xiāngzi.
items.en: David: Yes. Just these two suitcases.

items.zh: 刘京：我来帮你拿吧。车在外面。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒ lái bāng nǐ ná ba. Chē zài wàimiàn.
items.en: Liu Jing: Let me help you carry them. The car is outside.

items.zh: 大卫：太谢谢了！给你添麻烦了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tài xièxie le! Gěi nǐ tiān máfan le.
items.en: David: Thank you so much! Sorry for the trouble.

data.topic: 会话4 · Dialogue 4 (Arriving at the Hotel)

items.zh: 刘京：这是你的房间。你坐了十几个小时的飞机，一定很累了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zhè shì nǐ de fángjiān. Nǐ zuò le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí de fēijī, yīdìng hěn lèi le.
items.en: Liu Jing: This is your room. You flew for over 10 hours, you must be very tired.

items.zh: 大卫：还好。这个房间很好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Hái hǎo. Zhège fángjiān hěn hǎo.
items.en: David: I'm OK. This room is very nice.

items.zh: 刘京：你先休息一下吧。晚上我请你吃饭。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ xiān xiūxi yīxià ba. Wǎnshang wǒ qǐng nǐ chī fàn.
items.en: Liu Jing: Rest a bit first. I'll treat you to dinner this evening.

items.py: Dàwèi: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie nǐ.

items.zh: 刘京：有什么事，你给我打电话。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Yǒu shénme shì, nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: Liu Jing: If you need anything, give me a call.

items.zh: 刘京：那你休息吧，我先走了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nà nǐ xiūxi ba, wǒ xiān zǒu le.
items.en: Liu Jing: Well, get some rest. I'll go now.

data.topic: 替换与扩展 · Substitution and Extension

items.zh: 我们先去喝点儿咖啡，一会儿再来这儿吧。——先去吃点儿东西。
items.py: Wǒmen xiān qù hē diǎnr kāfēi, yīhuìr zài lái zhèr ba. —— Xiān qù chī diǎnr dōngxi.
items.en: Let's go have some coffee first... — First go eat something.

items.zh: 是和子告诉我的。——是玛丽告诉我的。
items.py: Shì Hézǐ gàosu wǒ de. —— Shì Mǎlì gàosu wǒ de.
items.en: Hezi told me. — Mary told me.

items.py: Huǒchē yào kāi le, kuài shàng chē ba.
items.en: The train is about to leave, hurry and get on.
I'll pick you up at the airport.

items.py: Wǒ qù huǒchē zhàn jiē nǐ.
items.en: I'll pick you up at the train station.

items.zh: 给你添麻烦了。——没关系，不麻烦。
items.py: Gěi nǐ tiān máfan le. —— Méi guānxi, bù máfan.
items.en: Sorry for the trouble. — It's fine, no trouble at all.

items.py: Nǐ de fēijī shì jǐ diǎn de?
Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ ná yīxià xíngli.
items.en: Please help me with my luggage.

items.zh: 你的护照和签证带了吗？
items.py: Nǐ de hùzhào hé qiānzhèng dài le ma?
items.en: Have you brought your passport and visa?

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (要……了 · About to Happen)

items.en: The train is about to leave.

items.py: Tā míngtiān jiù yào zǒu le.
items.en: He is leaving tomorrow. (time word + 就要...了)

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (是……的 · Emphasizing Details of Past Actions)

items.en: Where did you buy it? (emphasizing where)
It was Hezi who told me. (emphasizing who)

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (十几 / 几十 Approximate Numbers)

items.zh: 八点上课，现在七点五十二了，我们快走吧。→ 要上课了，我们快走吧。
items.py: Bā diǎn shàng kè, xiànzài qī diǎn wǔshí'èr le, wǒmen kuài zǒu ba. → Yào shàng kè le, wǒmen kuài zǒu ba.
items.en: (Rewrite with 要...了) Class at 8, it's 7:52 now → Class is about to start, let's hurry.

items.zh: 你再等等，他很快就来。→ 他就要来了，你再等等。
items.py: Nǐ zài děngdeng, tā hěn kuài jiù lái. → Tā jiù yào lái le, nǐ zài děngdeng.
items.en: (Rewrite with 就要...了) Wait a bit, he'll come soon → He's about to come, wait a bit.

items.zh: 李成日明天回国，我们去看看他吧。→ 李成日明天就要回国了。
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì míngtiān huí guó, wǒmen qù kànkan tā ba. → Lǐ Chéngrì míngtiān jiù yào huí guó le.
items.en: (Rewrite) Li Chengri returns home tomorrow → He's about to go home tomorrow.

items.zh: 饭很快就做好了，你们在这儿吃吧。→ 饭快要做好了/就要做好了，你们在这儿吃吧。
items.py: Fàn hěn kuài jiù zuò hǎo le, nǐmen zài zhèr chī ba. → Fàn kuài yào zuò hǎo le / jiù yào zuò hǎo le, nǐmen zài zhèr chī ba.
items.en: (Rewrite with 快要...了) Food will be ready soon → Food is about to be ready, eat here.

items.zh: 这种橘子真好吃，在哪儿买的？——是在旁边的商店买的。
items.py: Zhè zhǒng júzi zhēn hǎochī, zài nǎr mǎi de? —— Shì zài pángbiān de shāngdiàn mǎi de.
items.en: These oranges are delicious, where did you buy them? — At the shop next door. (是...的 practice)

items.zh: A: 你给玛丽打电话了吗？B: 打了。A: 她知道开车的时间了吗？B: 她昨天上午就知道了。A: 谁告诉她的？B: 是刘京告诉她的。
items.py: A: Nǐ gěi Mǎlì dǎ diànhuà le ma? B: Dǎ le. A: Tā zhīdào kāi chē de shíjiān le ma? B: Tā zuótiān shàngwǔ jiù zhīdào le. A: Shéi gàosu tā de? B: Shì Liú Jīng gàosu tā de.
items.en: (是...的 practice) A: Did you call Mary? B: Yes. A: Does she know the departure time? B: She knew yesterday morning. A: Who told her? B: Liu Jing told her.

items.zh: 你从哪儿来？你是怎么来的？
items.py: Nǐ cóng nǎr lái? Nǐ shì zěnme lái de?
items.en: Where are you from? How did you get here?
Why did you come to China?

items.zh: 我从法国来，我是坐飞机来的。我在北京语言大学学习汉语。
items.py: Wǒ cóng Fǎguó lái, wǒ shì zuò fēijī lái de. Wǒ zài Běijīng Yǔyán Dàxué xuéxí Hànyǔ.
items.en: (Retelling) I'm from France, I came by plane. I study Chinese at Beijing Language University.

items.zh: 在法国我没学过汉语，我不会说汉语，也不会写汉字。现在我会说一点儿了，我很高兴。
items.py: Zài Fǎguó wǒ méi xué guò Hànyǔ, wǒ bú huì shuō Hànyǔ, yě bú huì xiě Hànzì. Xiànzài wǒ huì shuō yīdiǎnr le, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: (Retelling) In France I hadn't studied Chinese; I couldn't speak or write it. Now I can speak a little, and I'm very happy.
